extracted.intended_audience: policymakers, legislative staff, civic technologists, funders, and stakeholders interested in modernizing legislatures
extracted.subtask_description: An organizational 'About' page describing POPVOX Foundation's mission, focus areas, methods, and approaches for assisting legislatures and public servants using technology, research, and engagement. It summarizes priorities rather than giving procedural rules for notice-and-comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonpartisan mission
rubrics_metrics.description: "POPVOX Foundation is a nonpartisan nonprofit organization with a mission to help democratic institutions keep pace with a rapidly changing world.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should be nonpartisan and aimed at helping democratic institutions adapt; activities include publications, events, prototypes, and technical assistance to help public servants and elected officials better serve constituents and make better policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governing capacity & technology
rubrics_metrics.description: "Helping democratic institutions keep pace with technological advancements."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Through technical assistance, research, prototyping, and maintaining collaborative communities of practice, the organization helps governments understand and incorporate emerging technologies into their work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative strengthening
rubrics_metrics.description: "Making legislatures around the world more effective, efficient, and transparent."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support legislatures by helping them leverage emerging technologies and open data platforms to modernize legislative workflows, enhance real-time information sharing, and ensure data sovereignty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constituent engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: "Strengthening the feedback loop between the public and their representatives."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Help legislators better connect with constituents so public policies prioritize public needs and civic participation is reinvigorated; engagement work should be aimed at improving responsiveness and representativeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy vision — focus on Congress as fulcrum
rubrics_metrics.description: "The POPVOX Foundation team views the US Congress as a fulcrum for policy and process evolution with influence on all branches and levels of American governance..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A modernized Congress is framed as having broad, positive ripple effects; priorities include investing in technology and continuous learning and fostering governance resilience in the age of AI and other exponential technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Providing cooperative assistance (engagement approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one element of the organization's four-pronged approach: "providing cooperative assistance."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cooperative assistance is delivered via informal advising, expert testimonies, training sessions, publications, and informal dialogues to aid Congress in its evolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exerting constructive external pressure (engagement approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one element of the organization's four-pronged approach: "exerting constructive external pressure."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities include identifying deficiencies, highlighting improvements, and celebrating significant advancements to maintain momentum for positive change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitating institutional knowledge sharing and networking (engagement approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one element of the organization's four-pronged approach: "facilitating institutional knowledge sharing and networking."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain collaborative communities of practice and networks to promote institutional learning and cross-jurisdictional sharing of best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: De-risking technology projects through prototypes and open source (engagement approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one element of the organization's four-pronged approach: "de-risking technology projects through prototypes, open source development and technical assistance."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use prototyping, open source development, and technical assistance to reduce risk in technology projects for legislatures and governing institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programmatic methods and channels
rubrics_metrics.description: "Through publications, events, prototypes, and technical assistance...research, prototyping, and maintaining collaborative communities of practice..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preferred methods include research, prototyping, publications, events, technical assistance, and communities of practice as primary vehicles for impact and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bipartisan legislative expertise and orientation
rubrics_metrics.description: "Co-founded in 2021 and led by proud former Congressional staffers from both sides of the aisle..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Team composition and approach emphasize bipartisan legislative experience, empathy, and respect for the Legislative branch as a mode of credibility and practical expertise in modernization efforts.
